steps.name: environment
steps.description: Persist headless environment variables to /etc/profile.d/react_headless.sh, validate Node.js (>=16) and npm (>=7), and ensure npm global bin is exported. Back up existing profile file, write a simple validated profile, and source it for the current shell so subsequent non-interactive scripts inherit CI, BROWSER, TERM, NODE_ENV, and PORT.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/dt3_bootcamp/ReactWebApp}"
[[ "$WORKSPACE" == *ReactWebApp* ]] || { echo "WORKSPACE must reference ReactWebApp" >&2; exit 2; }
TS=$(date +%s); PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/react_headless.sh
[ -f "$PROFILE" ] && sudo cp "$PROFILE" "$PROFILE.bak.$TS"
NPM_G_BIN=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || true)
sudo tee "$PROFILE" >/dev/null <<EOF
export CI=true
export TERM=dumb
export BROWSER=none
export NODE_ENV="${NODE_ENV:-development}"
export PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
EOF
[ -n "$NPM_G_BIN" ] && sudo bash -c "echo 'export PATH=$NPM_G_BIN:\$PATH' >> $PROFILE" || true
sudo chmod 644 "$PROFILE"
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "node not found" >&2; exit 3; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "npm not found" >&2; exit 4; }
NODE_V=$(node -v | sed -E 's/^v//'); MAJOR=${NODE_V%%.*}; [[ "$MAJOR" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$MAJOR" -ge 16 ]] || { echo "require Node.js >=16 (found $NODE_V)" >&2; exit 5; }
NPM_V=$(npm -v); NPM_MAJOR=${NPM_V%%.*}; [[ "$NPM_MAJOR" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$NPM_MAJOR" -ge 7 ]] || { echo "require npm >=7 (found $NPM_V)" >&2; exit 6; }
# Ensure environment is available immediately
# shellcheck disable=SC1090
source "$PROFILE"

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Build the app (production) and serve built assets with the project-local static server. Source persisted env, start server, perform a robust HTTP healthcheck with retries, write an evidence file on success, and shutdown the server gracefully (then forcefully if needed). Dump server logs on failure for debugging.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/dt3_bootcamp/ReactWebApp}"
[[ "$WORKSPACE" == *ReactWebApp* ]] || { echo "WORKSPACE must reference ReactWebApp" >&2; exit 2; }
# shellcheck disable=SC1090
[ -f /etc/profile.d/react_headless.sh ] && source /etc/profile.d/react_headless.sh || true
cd "$WORKSPACE"
: "${PORT:=3000}"; : "${NODE_ENV:=production}"; export PORT NODE_ENV CI BROWSER TERM
NODE_ENV=production npm run build --silent || { echo "build failed" >&2; exit 30; }
# choose server
if [ -x node_modules/.bin/serve ]; then SERVER_BIN=(node_modules/.bin/serve -s build -l "$PORT"); elif [ -x node_modules/.bin/http-server ]; then SERVER_BIN=(node_modules/.bin/http-server build -p "$PORT"); else echo "no local static server found" >&2; exit 31; fi
/tmp/react_validation_cleanup() { true; }
# start server
"${SERVER_BIN[@]}" >/tmp/react_serve.log 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
# robust healthcheck (max retries)
MAX=20; SLEEP=1
for i in $(seq 1 $MAX); do
  if curl -sSf "http://localhost:$PORT/" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "validation_success: http://localhost:$PORT/ pid=$SERVER_PID" > /tmp/react_validation_result.txt
    # shutdown gracefully
    kill "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    sleep 1
    if kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill -TERM "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 1; kill -9 "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep $SLEEP
done
# failure: dump logs and ensure server stopped
echo "validation failed: server did not respond" >&2
[ -f /tmp/react_serve.log ] && sed -n '1,200p' /tmp/react_serve.log >&2 || true
kill "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 1; kill -9 "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
exit 32

change_logs.message: Refined initial plan to: (1) add Node.js >=16 version check and improved /etc/profile.d creation (modified step_env_01); (2) update scaffolding (step_scaffold_01) to detect build tool or create a package.json populated with react, react-dom, react-scripts, jest, and serve and minimal src/public files; (3) update dependencies step (step_deps_01) to generate package-lock if missing and run npm ci deterministically, ensure node_modules/.bin/serve and local jest are installed; (4) update testing (step_test_01) to use project-local jest and fail clearly if missing; (5) update validation (step_validation_01) to use local node_modules/.bin/serve, robust start/stop (pkill) and healthcheck retries. These changes address the analyst's CRITICAL and HIGH feedback about missing build tooling, Node version validation, and brittle reliance on global jest/npx behavior.

Refined plan to address analyst feedback: (1) step_env_01: changed heredoc to allow parameter expansion, added backup of existing /etc/profile.d/react_headless.sh, validated env sourcing and added npm global bin PATH export; improved Node/npm version checks and npm >=7 validation. (2) step_scaffold_01: added safety to avoid overwriting package.json when it indicates Vite or unknown build tool; only scaffold when package.json missing; use broader semver ranges and create src/public files; do not force Vite changes. (3) step_deps_01: added yarn detection and deterministic yarn workflow (yarn install --frozen-lockfile --non-interactive) and added npm version compatibility check; if package-lock.json missing create it only after npm version check and warn about floating versions. Improved local binary verification by running their --version. (4) step_test_01: moved smoke test to src/__tests__/smoke.test.js and run npm test delegating flags to package.json; ensure test discovery. (5) step_validation_01: set explicit defaults before export, capture server PID, use PID to stop the server instead of pkill -f, include fallback to http-server if serve lacks expected flags, and produce /tmp/react_validation_result.txt as evidence. These changes address the CRITICAL/HIGH issues (heredoc expansion, yarn handling, Vite safety, PID-based process control, npm lockfile compatibility, env defaults and persistence verification).

Refined plan to address analyst feedback: (1) Updated step_env_01, step_scaffold_01, step_deps_01, step_test_01, step_validation_01 to avoid hardcoded workspace paths by honoring WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/dt3_bootcamp/ReactWebApp}" and failing early if WORKSPACE doesn't reference ReactWebApp. (2) step_env_01 simplified /etc/profile.d writing, backups, and now sources the file at script end. (6) step_validation_01 hardened server startup/healthcheck (improved retry loop, increased wait, log dump on failure, graceful then -9 kill fallback) and sources persisted env. These changes directly address the CRITICAL and HIGH recommendations around workspace handling, env sourcing, yarn checks, scaffolding behavior, and validation reliability.
